title: Rearranging Snell's Law
text: From n1 sin(theta1) = n2 sin(theta2), we get sin(theta2) = (n1/n2) sin(theta1) = (1.00/1.33) x 0.707 = 0.752 x 0.707 = 0.532

title: Finding the Refracted Angle
text: theta2 = arcsin(0.532) = 32.1 degrees. Notice the ray bends towards the normal (from 45 to 32 degrees) because light slows down when entering a denser medium (water). This is why objects in water appear closer to the surface than they actually are.
